projects.name: UK Enterprise PropTech SaaS

projects.outcome: Live platform now onboarding paying customers. Inbound voice agents handle calls in real time, classify communications across email, SMS, and WhatsApp, and route everything through a multi-tenant backend. Each tenant gets isolated vector stores, role-based access, and an audit trail.
projects.tech: ElevenLabs voice with a custom Python MCP server I wrote so the agent can hit live backend data in under a second. Two-tier OpenAI assistant architecture with per-company and per-conversation vector stores. .NET 8, Azure, Clean Architecture, CQRS underneath.
